name: Clearpath Warthog with UR10e Manipulation Package
summary: Clearpath's large all-terrain research UGV (280 kg, up to 272 kg payload) fitted with a Universal Robots UR10e arm as a preconfigured package that the maker offers for proof-of-concept robotics in agriculture and construction.

germany.statusNote: Clearpath names Generation Robots (Berlin) and MYBOTSHOP (Bergheim) as German distributors. MYBOTSHOP lists the Warthog base at 92,901 € incl. VAT and lists UR10/UR10e arms on the same page; Génération Robots lists the base from 94,640 € net. The UR10e package itself is priced on request.

sellers.name: MYBOTSHOP.DE
sellers.note: Base Warthog (no arm) "€ 92.901,00 inkl. 19% USt.", "Lieferzeit: ca. 5 Monate"; on the same page "Universal Robots UR10/UR10e" is offered as an add-on at "€ 36.473,50 - € 47.975,00" incl. VAT. No price for the assembled package.

sellers.name: Generation Robots
sellers.note: Base "Warthog Land Drone" "From €113,568.00 VAT incl. €94,640.00 VAT excl.", "Delivery within 11 to 12 weeks", with "Add to cart" and "Ask for a quote"; robotic arms listed as mountable accessories, no price for the UR10e package. Berlin office (+49 30 255 555 730) is listed by Clearpath as a German distributor.

The package lists the UR10e arm but no gripper.
Clearpath also shows a video of a Warthog with a UR20 arm; this record is the UR10e package.

evidence.task: Maker offers the package for proof-of-concept robotics in agriculture and construction and for mobile manipulation in remote settings
Warthog robots with UR10-class arms pick up garbage bags and carry them from a collection point to a deposit (Autotrans project)
evidence.note: Seller text: "The Autotrans project has deployed Warthog robots for autonomous waste management: picking up and transporting garbage bags"; arm model in that project not stated exactly.
